provenance.source: PR #6192 feat: Add config for ignoring absolute URLs (#5902), squash-merged 2025-02-12 as 32c7bcc0f
provenance.note: Introduced by this PR: it hoisted `!isAbsoluteURL(requestedURL)` into a local and OR-ed the new flag clause outside the `baseURL &&` guard, so the guard covers only the relative-URL case: with `allowAbsoluteUrls: false` and no configured base, the disjunct is true and `combineURLs(undefined, url)` reads `.replace` off undefined. The later fix #6833 parenthesises the disjunct and adds the three-argument test that pins it. Scope at this head: `getUri()` passes the flag (the PR added that call) while `lib/adapters/http.js` still calls `buildFullPath(config.baseURL, config.url)` with two arguments, so an ordinary request only ignores the option until #6810 plumbs it into the adapter — after which this line is the TypeError reported in issue #6832 for `axios.get(url, {allowAbsoluteUrls: false})`.

keywords: the false flag bypasses the guard that requires a base
operator precedence drops the base check

bugs.note: the flag disjunct is grouped outside the check that a base exists, so turning the flag off without a base hands undefined to the URL joiner and the call throws instead of returning the requested URL
